Definition: adverb from a compound of G1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a presumed compound of G4383 and G2983 (compare G4381); in a way not accepting the person, i.e. impartially:--without respect of persons.
BiblicalUsage: Peter says to call on the Father who without respect of persons judges according to every man's work, and to pass the time of your sojourning in fear. God weighs the work, not the face, the standing, or the name.
TheologicalSignificance: God does not play favourites, and that is both our comfort and our warning.
